The '''Quingarus Systems cook-droid''' was a [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] model produced by the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]].

==Characteristics==
The droid was humanoid in stature, with two arms and legs. It wore a cooking apron.

==History==
[[Hologram/Legends|Holographic]] commercials featuring the droid played during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
